text: We are underway in match six!
Flash signals an immediate forward charge.
And Flash has broken clean through the middle! Not a single ivory shirt between the electric blue striker and the open net!
Prompt surges forward down the right flank!
GOAL! Prompt slots it in from point-blank range, and Manus FC take a shock lead! It is Gemini Flash nil, Manus FC one!
A sudden loss of balance for Prompt along the touchline, crashing down hard, but the self-righting routine is already kicking in.
Trace gets clattered by Spark!
Spark goes down in the immediate counter-challenge!
Disastrous own goal by Flash! Manus FC lead two-nil!
Spark stumbles in the centre circle and hits the deck, adding to Gemini Flash's early mechanical misery.
Trace calls for calm at the back, urging a total defensive reset behind the magenta ball.
Prompt advances nicely down the left touchline, retaining steady possession for the ivory-shirted side.
Prompt slips the ball past the line and is clean through on goal down the right channel!
GOAL! Prompt converts right at the goal mouth! Gemini Flash nil, Manus FC three!
Trace alerts the frontline that possession is secure and asks Prompt to protect the middle.
Trace charges straight through the middle!
GOAL! Trace thumps it in from close range! What a ruthless display, it is Gemini Flash nil, Manus FC four!
A sweeping strike whistles just wide of the post!
Rattled into the bevelled corner, and the push-panel propels the ball back into play with real ferocity.
Trace communicates the plan to contest the loose ball and boot it straight upfield.
Trace breaks free on the right with nothing in the way!
Trace marches right to the line!
GOAL! Trace makes it five! Gemini Flash nil, Manus FC five!
Relentless attacking pressure here, with Gemini Flash pinned completely inside their own half.
Flash initiates a rare burst forward into the attacking third.
At last, the electric blue shirts apply sustained pressure deep in Manus territory, searching desperately for a breakthrough.
Spark scans the pitch, broadcasting an active sweep to relocate the rolling ball.
Trace strides effortlessly up the left channel with seconds ticking away in the half.
Half time: Gemini nil, Manus five.
Straight into the second half and Manus FC pick up right where they left off, penning the opposition in.
Agonisingly close! Just a whisker away from the far corner!
Prompt steps in with a crunching tackle on Flash right at the mouth of goal to snuff out the danger!
Flash signals intent to push hard towards the attacking goal.
GOAL! Flash pulls one back from the right channel! Gemini Flash FC one, Manus FC five!
Flash loses footing on the touchline and hits the deck.
Driven wide of the open target!
Spark motors down the left channel!
GOAL! Spark slots it home! Two in quick succession! Gemini Flash two, Manus FC five!
Flash is clean through again! A sudden surge of momentum for the electric blues as they hunt another!
Heavy collision as Flash takes down Trace in the final third!
GOAL! Prompt halts the comeback in its tracks! Gemini Flash two, Manus FC six!
Trace communicates that the challenge is on and requests middle coverage from Prompt.
Shaved past the upright once more!
GOAL! Trace scrambles it over the line point-blank! That surely seals it, Gemini Flash two, Manus FC seven!
Electric blues pressing hard as the minutes tick away.
GOAL! Flash bundles it home from close range! Gemini Flash three, Manus FC seven!
Teammates collide in midfield and Flash tumbles over!
Back up and Flash is clean through on goal once more!
Flash lands a solid challenge to dispossess Prompt!
Prompt bowls Spark over cleanly!
Push-panel catapults the ball clear!
Flash lets Spark know sensors are sweeping the arena to track the magenta ball.
Thumped deep into the corner and the mechanical ram sends it flying back into play.
GOAL! Trace taps it in from point-blank range in the final minute! Gemini Flash three, Manus FC eight!
Skimming inches wide of the net!
Flash tumbles in the box!
GOAL! Flash scrambles up and strokes it in! Gemini Flash four, Manus FC eight!
Full-time: Gemini Flash 4, Manus FC 8. Up next at 12:00 London, Dynamo Datacenter against AFC Fable!
